# Local monochrome technology marks

The brand SVG geometry is preserved; fill is normalized to the pitch's ink color.

- TypeScript, Node.js, Hono, Zod, JSON, Firebase, HTML5, CSS, JavaScript: [Simple Icons](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/tree/develop/icons). [License and brand disclaimer](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/blob/develop/LICENSE.md).
- xAI: [LobeHub provider icons](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons/tree/master/packages/static-svg/icons), `xai.svg`. [Project license](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons/blob/master/LICENSE).
- Roadmap concepts: original neutral line pictograms embedded in the page; these are not corporate logos.

Firebase's mark accompanies the explicit name "Firebase / Firestore". The website makes no affiliation claim.
